gitPolicy: No push. Workers make no branches, worktrees, stashes or commits. Serial finalization makes one local commit. Evidence goes under tmp/vim-host-20261111/<planId>/ as .log/.txt/.json files only, because the boundary test scans .ts/.mjs/.html files repository-wide.

reviewContext.issueReference: none supplied; workflowInput.requestedOutcome is authoritative (session opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-836; design accepted comm-019227)
reviewContext.userProblem: emaki/vim flattens the host extension points a downstream host needs: application actions, announce/popup/platform/keymap/composition/visibility/history hooks, scroll/type hooks, the full snapshot, tapMode and userEvent-classified external updates. The downstream host therefore cannot replace its private engine without behavior loss.
requiredOutcomes: Host action registry with emaki.* ids and namespaced host ids; unregistered ids do nothing (D16).
VimSnapshot through vim().state, onChange, controller.snapshot and subscribe, with coalesced delivery (D18, D21).
Exported createVimController wrapper plus the VimHost/VimSnapshot and related types (D19).
Render switches for the search, hints and hop marks (D20).
Public tapMode (D23) and noteUpdate userEvent forwarding (D24).
Class-2 reference tests ported; README documented; core bytes unchanged; Tauri check and smoke green.
constraints: No core src edits outside src/vim.
No vactr/solid-js//editor/ text in src, test or scripts.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D16: one host action registry keyed by action id; emaki.* ids are ordinary keys; unregistered ids are no-ops; hop.* stays engine-owned; namespaced host ids are allowed in n/x/i (design-vim.md §12.2).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Removes the downstream-specific action names while keeping the existing emaki.* ids and ex aliases working. The schema stays registry-independent because compileKeymap runs before or without a registry.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D17: optional VimHooks (announce, closePopupWithEscape, platform, matchesDefaultKeymap, compositionActive, isVisible, historyReduced, scrollCaret, scrollLines, typeText, defaultKey). Each provided member fully replaces today's default (§12.3).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Plain vim() usage is unchanged, and a host with its own surface can supply every reference behavior.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D18/D21: VimSnapshot extends VimState and is the payload of vim().state, onChange, controller.snapshot and subscribe. Delivery is coalesced per public call and deduplicated over the full snapshot (§12.4).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One additive type for both paths. Coalescing keeps the existing controller.test.ts 'notifies once' case passing unedited.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D19: export createVimController through an index.ts wrapper over the existing C1 VimHost contract. The wrapper adds the default scheduler and platform (§12.5).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: No second host contract. Purity is preserved because navigator and timers stay in index.ts and adapter.ts.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D20: the search, hints and hop mark renderers can be switched off one by one through render; there are no renderer callbacks (§12.6).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: A host keeps its own framework views and renders them from the snapshot.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D22: no extension point touches core; core bundle bytes stay identical to 6351463.
D23/D24: tapMode is public, and noteUpdate forwards userEvent verbatim when the property is present and otherwise falls back to the legacy heuristic.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Needed for parity with the reference mode toggle and with dot-repeat and macro recording of host-dispatched edits.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-11 round 1: (a) IR-W3-1: host-action handler exceptions follow reference parity. On the keymap path the mapper catch-all (src/vim/mapper.ts:78-82) swallows the exception and resets; src/vim/mapper.ts is not edited and is assigned to no plan. On the ex-alias path the exception propagates out of submitPrompt. p05 replaces its 'propagates handler exceptions' case with two parity cases in test/vim/host-actions.test.ts. p01's aggregate is narrowed to 'npx vitest run test/vim --exclude test/vim/host-actions.test.ts', and the unfiltered run stays a serial reconciliation gate. (b) IR-W3-2: VimController.blur() is added additively (host.ts) and delegated through wrapped() (controller.ts); p07 adds the hop and operator-pending blur snapshot cases. (c) p02, p03, p04, p06, p08 and p09 move to acceptedDependencies; only p01, p05 and p07 remain.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Blocked plan: vimhost-p01-engine-contract. Its 'npx vitest run test/vim' aggregate failed on the sibling-owned p05 regression in test/vim/host-actions.test.ts. The fix needed src/vim/mapper.ts, which no plan owns. Reference parity was confirmed by a 0-byte tmp/vim-host-20261111/reconcile-wave-003/mapper-vs-reference.diff. Resolved gaps: the IR-W3-1 contract mismatch (p01, p05) and the IR-W3-2 facade blur gap (p01, p07). Plan IDs, writePaths and artifactRoots are unchanged. The design-vim.md §12.2 exception sentence is corrected by the design author at finalization.

intentionalTradeoffs: The snapshot cursorShape is the engine value (underline for operator-pending), while the Vim.cursorShape getter and the cursor marks keep block (§12.4).
onChange now also fires on cursor, hint and hop changes (D21).
Keymap validation cannot check that a host id is registered.
The platform hook may stay inert if no class-2 case needs a platform-dependent pass-through (user-qa #7).
supportedEdgeCases: A handler returning null reports 'no diagnostics' only for the diagnostic ids.
A numeric return is clamped and extends the selection in visual mode.

Handler exceptions behave as in the reference (amendment round 1, IR-W3-1). On the keymap path the mapper swallows the exception and resets. On the ex-alias path the exception propagates to the caller of submitPrompt.
hop.* unknowns and undotted ids are rejected with 'unknown action id'; host ids are rejected in o and c.
An explicit null userEvent is forwarded; an omitted userEvent uses the heuristic.
tapMode is a no-op before attach and while a prompt is open.
With every renderer off, a host can pass a no-op marks implementation.

test/vim/surface-host.test.ts and test/vim/note-update.test.ts driving the exported createVimController with a custom host (accepted uncommitted working-tree implementation, finalized at serial reconciliation).

acceptanceCriteria: core-before.json is written before any source edit.
The C-R5-1 types are added additively in host.ts.
The shim uses hooks, actions and render with today's defaults.
The ex aliases dispatch through the registry.
The facade exposes snapshot, coalesced subscribe, tapMode and noteUpdate userEvent forwarding (present including null is forwarded verbatim; absent uses the heuristic).
All existing test/vim suites pass unedited.
Amendment round 1 (IR-W3-2): VimController.blur(): void is added additively in host.ts, and the facade delegates it through wrapped() to ReferenceController.blur, whose semantics are unchanged.

Amendment round 1 (IR-W3-1): src/vim/mapper.ts is not edited. Reference parity governs. The sibling-owned test/vim/host-actions.test.ts belongs to vimhost-p05-actions-tests and is excluded from p01's aggregate.
The <leader>e host action, diagnostic move/clamp/visual/null, unregistered no-op, ex aliases, schema rules and exception propagation are tested.

Amendment round 1 (IR-W3-1): the exception case is replaced by two reference-parity cases. A keymap-bound handler exception is swallowed: no throw, pending is cleared and the next key works. An ex-alias exception propagates out of submitPrompt. src/vim/mapper.ts is not edited.
The class-2 application-actions table is logged.
All snapshot fields, hints after the delay, hop labels, the delivery rule and the render switches are tested.

Amendment round 1 (IR-W3-2): reference blur snapshot cases are tested through the exported createVimController. Hop: blur() gives hop === null, pending === '' and one delivery. Operator-pending: blur() returns mode to normal with pending === ''. No src edits.
The class-2 hints/hop UI-data table is logged.
